title: Derivative-based local refinement of 8-layer stack from R4 seed
scientific_hypothesis: The R4 thickness vector represents a local optimum; derivative-based optimization with line-search will map Hessian curvature and identify whether small perturbations can escape this local maximum to achieve higher target scores.
design_principle: Local gradient-based optimization around verified high-performing configuration to test if current score ceiling is a true local optimum or an optimization artifact.
proposed_topology: exactly 8 finite layers from the incident side: ZnSe / ZnS / ZnSe / ZnS / ZnSe / ZnS / ZnSe / ZnS
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band
Minimize mean transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness tolerances ±1.5% represent realistic deposition uniformity
theory_basis: Gradient-based optimization theory for continuous design variables
Local optimum verification through Hessian analysis
expected_advantages: Precise mapping of local design space curvature
Efficient convergence if R4 is near global optimum
Quantifiable optimization progress through line-search iterations
known_risks: May converge to same local optimum as iteration_19
Limited exploration if bounds are too restrictive
Derivative-based methods may struggle with non-smooth objective landscape
execution_request_english: Perform one bounded TMM thickness optimization for an exactly 8-layer planar stack. Use the fixed material sequence from the incident side: ZnSe / ZnS / ZnSe / ZnS / ZnSe / ZnS / ZnSe / ZnS. Optimize only the physical thickness of each finite layer within the user-declared bounds. Do not optimize material identity or layer count in this route. Optimize an 8-layer planar dielectric stack on Ge substrate with material sequence Air|ZnSe|ZnS|ZnSe|ZnS|ZnSe|ZnS|ZnSe|ZnS|Ge. Initialize thicknesses at [429.3, 71.1, 69.6, 50.3, 674.6, 71.4, 49.2, 548.5] nm. Apply bounded optimization with ±1.5% uniform perturbation around each seed value. Use derivative-based local optimizer with line-search. Evaluate under normal-incidence unpolarized illumination. Compute mean transmittance in 8000-11000 nm passband (maximize) and 3000-5000 nm stopband (minimize). Total layer count fixed at 8. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 8000-11000 nm, 3000-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band; Low transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count not exceeding 16.
revision_reason: Direct implementation of feedback directive: seed from R4 thickness vector, ±1.5% perturbation, derivative-based optimizer with line-search to map Hessian curvature around current performance peak.
